text:
Predicates:
WildTurkeyType(x) ::: x is a type of wild turkey.
IsType(x, y) ::: x is a wild turkey of type y.
Eastern(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
Osceola(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
Goulds(x) ::: x is a Gould’s wild turkey.
Merram(x) ::: x is a Merriam’s wild turkey.
RioGrande(x) ::: x is a Rio Grande wild turkey.
Ocellated(x) ::: x is an Ocellated wild turkey.

Premises:
¬IsType(tom, eastern) ::: Tom is not an Eastern wild turkey.
¬IsType(tom, osceola) ::: Tom is not an Osceola wild turkey.
¬IsType(tom, goulds) ∧ ¬IsType(tom, merriam) ∧ ¬IsType(tom, riogrande) ::: Tom is also not a Gould's wild turkey, or a Merriam's wild turkey, or a Rio Grande wild turkey.
∃y (WildTurkeyType(y) ∧ IsType(tom, y)) ::: Tom is a wild turkey.

Conclusion:
IsType(tom, eastern) ::: Tom is an Eastern wild turkey.
